description: This file defines schema hints and utility functions for configuration UI, including handling sensitive data, schema path collection, and hint building for a configuration system.

methods.name: getLog
methods.description: Initializes and returns a logger instance for the config/schema subsystem.

methods.name: isKernelOwnedChannelHintPath
methods.description: Checks if a given path is a kernel-owned channel hint path.

methods.name: isPluginOwnedChannelHintPath
methods.description: Checks if a given path is a plugin-owned channel hint path.

methods.name: isWhitelistedSensitivePath
methods.description: Checks if a path matches whitelisted sensitive key suffixes.

methods.name: matchesSensitivePattern
methods.description: Checks if a path matches any sensitive regex patterns.

methods.name: isSensitiveConfigPath
methods.description: Determines if a path is considered sensitive based on patterns and whitelist.

methods.name: buildBaseHints
methods.description: Builds default UI hints for configuration fields and groups.

methods.name: applySensitiveHints
methods.description: Marks hints as sensitive based on config paths.

methods.name: applySensitiveUrlHints
methods.description: Adds URL-specific sensitive tags to hints.

methods.name: collectMatchingSchemaPaths
methods.description: Recursively collects schema paths matching a condition.

methods.name: isUnwrappable
methods.description: Type guard to check if an object has an unwrap() method for Zod schemas.

methods.name: mapSensitivePaths
methods.description: Recursively marks schema paths as sensitive based on schema analysis.
